patch_description: Expands the multi-start to 8 diverse seeds (symmetric base, its perturbations, hexagonal-lattice-in-triangle seed, concentric "rings" seed, and several fixed-seed Dirichlet samples), each refined with a two-phase hill climb: a soft global-perturbation phase followed by a targeted hard phase that pushes vertices of the minimal triangle apart. Uses a ~8s time budget split across seeds, vectorized min-area over all 165 triplets, and barycentric folding for feasibility. More starts plus cheap vectorized evaluation should lift the normalized min-area well above the current 0.01.
